column1: # What each end-to-end stage's result depends on — read by Tools/e2e-inputs.py, which hashes it into the stage's key.
# **CARRIED is a development-loop shortcut, never a gate.** A stage whose key is unchanged since a fresh pass on the
# same E2E Mac and macOS build is carried forward instead of run. A merge or a release needs a FRESH pass of every
# stage on its own build — `make e2e-full`, then `Tools/e2e-status.sh require-fresh <build>`, which refuses CARRIED.
# One row per input, four tab-separated fields: stage, kind, value, reason.
#   stage   a name in KNOWN_STAGES (Tools/e2e.sh); `*` for an input of every stage; `-` for an `unexercised` row
#   module  a SwiftPM target and, transitively, every target it depends on — read off `swift package dump-package`
#   own     a SwiftPM target's own files only: the app target, which every stage runs and which links nearly
#           everything, so claiming it whole would make every stage claim every source change
#   path    a file, a directory or a glob, relative to the repository; it must match at least one file
#   unexercised  a target no stage claims, with the reason (test targets are never in the bundle and need no row)
# **A stage claims the subject modules its assertions exercise, not everything the app links.** What the app does
# incidentally on the way — the model service prewarmed on every lookup, the ledger opened at launch — is not a
# stage's subject unless the stage asserts on it; unit tests cover it, and the full run before a merge catches the
# rest. When in doubt a module is claimed: a false skip is far worse than an extra run.
# Every stage also depends on its own region of Tools/e2e.sh and on everything in that file outside the regions;
# those are hashed without being listed here. The scan in Tools/tests/test_e2e_incremental.py holds this file to the
# tree: every stage has an entry, every pattern matches a file, every shipped module is claimed or listed below, every
# `$helpers/…` a region uses is declared for it.
